concept: limestone cyclorama figure study with one continuous opaque cobalt sculptural screen
negative_en: excessive HDR, unrealistic hands, low resolution, 3D render look, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, cartoon style, broken facial features
prompt_en:
Create a photorealistic full-length fine-art fashion figure study inside a pale limestone cyclorama gallery. Show one unmistakably adult woman from the top of her head to both matte ankle boots. She wears an opaque charcoal ankle-length dance unitard. Use the supplied portrait only as an appearance reference for visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture. The model holds a balanced asymmetric contrapposto: one arm rises away from the head, the other bends outward from the waist, and the legs separate enough to form clean body-edge negative-space cutouts. One freestanding continuous cobalt-blue sculptural screen follows a broad S-curve from an overhead mount to the floor. Its single uninterrupted opaque path crosses the central chest, abdomen, and pelvis. Visible shoulder, waist, hip, thigh, and lower-leg contours align naturally across both sides of the screen, making the hidden anatomy read as one coherent standing figure. A hard gridded key light rakes diagonally from camera left, carving directional shape light across the face, limbs, screen edges, and limestone; a restrained opposing rim separates hair and the outer silhouette. Frame vertically at eye level with the entire figure and both ends of the sculptural screen visible. Preserve realistic lens perspective, detailed opaque materials, natural skin texture, and crisp but photographic shadow transitions. At full length, one unmistakably adult figure is the complete study subject from head to both grounded boots. Across the clothed central form, one stable opaque coverage path remains continuous over non-explicit anatomy from chest to pelvis. At native detail, body contour continues plausibly around both edges of the occluding form through aligned shoulders, waist, hips, and legs. A diagonal gridded key ensures directional light and continuous body-bounded negative space model three-dimensional form around the arms, waist, and separated legs. Within the vertical eye-level frame, head torso support limbs and pose remain readable as one holistic figure study including the complete screen and grounded feet. Use a 65 mm full-frame lens at moderate working distance to preserve calm, realistic proportions. Leave a narrow limestone margin above the hair and below the boots while the screen casts one attached edge shadow that proves its freestanding depth.

Generate a new photograph. Image 1 contributes only visible adult facial proportions, long dark wavy hair, and natural skin texture as bounded appearance cues; the new gallery scene, full-body pose, wardrobe, screen geometry, lighting, and framing follow this runtime prompt.

Avoid: excessive HDR, unrealistic hands, low resolution, 3D render look, plastic-looking skin, illustration look, cartoon style, broken facial features
